hooks.name: test-first-before-task
hooks.description: Before each spec task starts, remind the agent of the spec's working rules so tasks stay small, test-first, and within the steering documents.

action.prompt: Before writing code for this task: (1) re-read .kiro/steering/tech.md and .kiro/steering/privacy.md and the requirement numbers listed in the task's _Requirements:_ line; (2) if the task is marked (test-first), write the failing Swift Testing tests from those acceptance criteria first and confirm they fail; (3) keep Models/Metrics Foundation-only and put all framework access behind the service protocols from design.md; (4) change only files this task needs; (5) when done, report files changed and the test results, and do not tick the task if scripts/test.sh is not green.
